summary: ICON plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a press release announcing the scheduling of its third quarter 2026 earnings conference call. Results will be released after market close on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, with a call and webcast on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 8:00am ET; a replay will be available about one hour later. Signed by CFO Nigel Clerkin. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are present. This is a routine earnings-timing notice, so no risk-arb angle applies.
